publisher: South Carolina Secretary of State through SC.gov subscriber services
supersession_scope: Supplemental contract and schema-review evidence only; preserves the October assessment and does not change any readiness wave or admit a connector.

policy.ownership: Official South Carolina service and subscriber agreement document the Secretary of State corporate bulk product.
policy.allowed_use: Record cited public documentation observations only; this reference grants no use or acquisition rights for licensed source data.
policy.terms: Registration, signed subscriber agreement, ACH payment and subscriber transfer credentials are documented prerequisites, not completed or authorized actions. Product-specific terms and applicable limitations require review before any order.
policy.retention: Retain this versioned evidence and citations only. The PDF and source records are not retained by this prerequisite.
policy.attribution: Attribute observations to official URLs, the observation date, document revision and coordinating-agent evidence origin.
policy.redistribution: No product-specific grant for transformation, derived commercial publication or redistribution has been established; these rights remain unresolved.

subscriber_agreement.retrieval_evidence_origin: coordinating-agent observation supplied to this documentation workstream
subscriber_agreement.citation_scope: Agreement pages 1, 2 and 12-14 document subscription and product terms; the URL filename does not update the document footer revision.

service_page.retrieval_evidence_origin: coordinating-agent observation supplied to this documentation workstream
service_page.agreement_requirement: Complete and sign the subscriber agreement; original signatures are required.

business_filings_portal.retrieval_evidence_origin: coordinating-agent observation supplied to this documentation workstream
business_filings_portal.good_standing_boundary: Good Standing indicates legal existence not terminated or dissolved; it does not establish current operation. Nonprofit good standing does not establish solicitation authority.
business_filings_portal.identity_notice_scope: Identity verification notice applies to applicable online filing login; application to bulk delivery is not established.

corporation_product.name: Corporation Bulk Data
corporation_product.archive_name_boundary: Exact product documentation only; filenames are not required acquisition inputs, a field schema, or proof of completeness.
corporation_product.documented_cadence: Monthly; pushed on the fifth to a subscriber FTP endpoint.
documented_prerequisites: signed subscriber agreement with original signatures
corporation_product.separate_product_boundary: New-filings and UCC products are separate offerings and do not establish a complete corporate baseline.
corporation_product.change_contract_boundary: CORP_TXN.ZIP is not assumed to be a complete delta or change log. Baseline-versus-delta semantics, deletions, corrections, replay, checksums and control totals remain unresolved.
corporation_product.delivery_boundary: Documented FTP push does not establish a supported secure-transfer, retry, cancellation, restart or replay contract.

schema_review.zip_rule: Preserve ZIP5 and ZIP4 as separate strings; do not infer either from archive names or collapse them into a single numeric value.
schema_review.person_field_rule: Exclude registered-agent and person-linked fields from any later projection until current schema and privacy review establish permitted fields.
schema_review.operating_site_rule: Registered-agent, registered-office and mailing addresses do not establish operating sites.
schema_review.status_rule: Registry standing is a legal filing fact, not current operating-establishment status.
schema_review.population_rule: The filing population and product scope must be verified; no statewide operating-business denominator or completeness claim is authorized.
